On 11/14/2016 04:55 PM, Mark Hardaker wrote:
> How can I get lavaan output to two decimal places?

summary(fit, nd = 2)

(although this currently (0.5) only affects the parameter estimates
section).

Most output of lavaan accepts the 'nd' argument, eg

print(fitMeasures(fit), nd = 2)
print(standardizedSolution(fit), nd = 2)


Yves.
